# SmartDelegate

> Identity and access management for LLM agents. A human lends an agent one role they hold, for one task. The agent gets a short-lived capability token that cannot carry more than the role allows; a sub-agent's token can only carry less; every tool call is decided by Cedar policy with default deny; fields the principal may not see are removed before data reaches the model; budgets and human approvals are enforced; revoking a user ends every token issued for them; every decision is appended to a hash-chained audit log. Reference engine in Python, ports in Java, Node.js, Go, PHP and Rust, a REST daemon, HTTP and MCP proxies, bridges to identity providers and clouds. Build 0.3.0, Apache-2.0, no independent security review.

In-process checks bind an agent that cooperates. The boundary an agent cannot skip is a proxy that alone holds the upstream credential and is the agent's only network path. Read LIMITATIONS before relying on any of it.

- [README](README.md): what it is, the rule ids, how it is tested, what was not run
- [Limitations](docs/LIMITATIONS.md): what this build does not do; read first

## Specification

- [Operations](spec/API.md): every operation, JSON in and out; engine configuration; the HTTP and MCP proxy contracts
- [Roles](spec/ROLES.md): `roles.json`, ceilings, issuance order, what happens when a human loses a role
- [Policy subset](spec/POLICY_SUBSET.md): the portable Cedar subset every engine evaluates
- [Porting](spec/PORTING.md): byte formats (canonical JSON, token, bundle, audit record, state directory) and the rules that are easy to get wrong
- [OpenAPI](spec/openapi.yaml): the REST daemon
- [Scope](docs/SCOPE.md): architecture, the decision API and decision order (section 7), schemas (section 8)
- [Threat model](docs/THREAT_MODEL.md): per threat, what the system does, the test, and what it does not do

## Integrate

- [Integration guide](docs/INTEGRATE.md): "Connect your IAM", "Connect your agent system", the minimum viable integration, the checklist before calling it enforced
- [Adopter interfaces](interfaces/README.md): IdentitySource, DirectorySource, RoleCatalog, EnforcementPoint, AgentRuntime, ApprovalChannel, AuditSink, RevocationFeed; reference implementations; the contract test kit
- [Bridges](docs/BRIDGES.md): identity providers, directory sync, role ceilings from cloud permissions, down-scoped cloud credentials; what is verified (Keycloak) and what is not
- [Integrations](integrations/README.md): the adapter, LangChain, LlamaIndex, function calling, MCP server, CI hooks
- [MCP server](integrations/mcp/README.md): question tools, monitoring tools (`--ops`), privileged tools (`--admin`, `--allow-tools`), `--govern`
- [Ports](ports/README.md): engines in other languages and what each contains

## Governance

- [Framework](docs/FRAMEWORK.md): what kind of control this is, the principles it implements and their limits, the IAIso mapping with its status, mappings to NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, NIST SP 800-207 and OWASP guidance, the signals in and out
- [IAIso map](spec/iaiso-map.json): the same mapping as data
